final: SELECT s.City, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS num_schools, SUM(CASE WHEN f.`NSLP Provision Status`='Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_provision_schools FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode=f.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet=1 AND s.GSserved='K-8' GROUP BY s.City ORDER BY num_schools DESC
